name: Waterfly III
tagline: Log expenses on the go against your Firefly III books
description:
Waterfly III puts your Firefly III finances on your phone. Add and edit transactions as you spend, look up an account balance, check a budget, glance at the charts on the dashboard, and see which bills are coming up — without opening the web interface.

It can read incoming notifications from your banking or payment app and pre-fill a transaction from them, so logging a card payment is a couple of taps. Split transactions, several currencies, photo attachments and fingerprint lock are all supported, and the app carries no trackers.

You need your own Firefly III server; this is an unofficial client and stores nothing on its own. It is meant as a companion for everyday entries rather than a replacement for everything the web interface can do.
